title: Query-Efficient Rejection Sampling for Parallel Masked Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.22238v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) accelerate generation by unmasking multiple tokens in parallel, but sampling these tokens independently ignores their correlations and biases the output. Anari et al. (2026) corrected this bias with rejection sampling, decomposing the log acceptance probability into a sum of token-level terms, but the evaluation requires one score query per unmasked token. We propose the Single-Increment Rejection Sampler (SIRS), which provides an estimate of the log acceptance probability from a single randomly sampled increment at the cost of one query. SIRS then converts a Poisson number of clipped estimates into accept/reject decisions through a Bernoulli factory adapted from Chen et al. (2026). Since each query returns the conditionals of all remaining tokens in the block, we further Rao-Blackwellize each increment by averaging over these tokens at no extra cost, thereby reducing clipping. translated_title: 面向并行掩码扩散的查询高效拒绝采样
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散模型（MDMs）通过并行解掩码多个token来加速生成，但独立采样这些token忽略了它们之间的相关性，从而使输出产生偏差。Anari等人（2026）利用拒绝采样纠正了这一偏差，将对数接受概率分解为token级项之和，但评估时需要对每个被解掩码的token进行一次分数查询。我们提出了单增量拒绝采样器，它仅以一次查询的代价，从单个随机采样的增量中提供对数接受概率的估计。随后，SIRS通过改编自Chen等人（2026）的伯努利工厂，将泊松数量的截断估计转换为接受/拒绝决策。由于每次查询都会返回块中所有剩余token的条件分布，我们进一步以零额外代价对这些token取平均来对每个增量进行Rao-Blackwell化，从而减少截断误差。我们证明了KL散度……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出单增量拒绝采样器（SIRS），每次仅需一次查询即可估计并行掩码扩散模型拒绝采样中的对数接受概率，并结合伯努利工厂与Rao-Blackwell化显著降低查询成本并减少截断偏差。
en_tdlr: We propose the Single-Increment Rejection Sampler (SIRS), which estimates the log acceptance probability for rejection sampling in parallel masked diffusion with only a single query per increment, combining a Bernoulli factory with Rao-Blackwellization to reduce query cost and clipping bias.
